title: A Refined Sum-Product Estimate via Higher Energies
summary: Let $A\subset\mathbb{R}$ be a finite set. Combining the multiplicative slope estimate of Rudnev--Stevens, Cushman's higher-energy regularization, Shakan's $d^+$--$d^\times$ decomposition, and Solymosi's classical sum--product estimate, we prove \[ |AA|^{204}|A+A|^{301}\gtrsim |A|^{675}, \] where $\gtrsim$ suppresses a fixed polylogarithmic factor in $|A|$. Consequently, for every $\varepsilon>0$, \[ \max\{|A+A|,|AA|\}\gg_\varepsilon |A|^{135/101-\varepsilon}. \] The proof is organized around two intermediate estimates.
